name: Extreme synchronized particle accelerator district
assumptions: Illustrative community-style modular factory, not a measured save or a recipe-complete production planner.
Counts represent a full production building mix including upstream processing. Logistics outside the stated boundary do not draw power here.
Machines run at full duty. No Somersloop boost. All unmarked clocks are 100 percent.
Coordinates and spacing in meters define a rectangular block graph. Pole branches use four machines per pole. Feed enters at the origin.
Normal crafting cycles share the mean draw. The peak column conservatively synchronizes every variable-power machine.
Scale target: three nuclear pasta per minute from six synchronized accelerators. Copper powder and cubes arrive by train, except for the stated support wing.
The six pasta cycles last 120 seconds. A linear ramp from 500 to 1500 MW per accelerator approximates the variable power curve. This is an extreme synchronized district, not the LV sizing baseline.
The transformer can thermally exceed its nominal rating until a local trip. This heat study does not use the hard-rated escrow transformer link.
The charged capacitor bank follows a 95 percent transformer setpoint. Initial energy is explicit. Extra headroom and staggered cycles are alternatives.
